arxiv-1910-08630.title: Betatron frequency and the Poincaré rotation number
arxiv-1910-08630.creator: Sergei Nagaitsev, Timofey Zolkin
arxiv-1910-08630.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Sergei Nagaitsev, Timofey Zolkin. Symplectic maps are routinely used to describe single-particle dynamics in circular accelerators. In the case of a linear accelerator map, the rotation number (the betatron frequency) can be easily calculated from the map itself. In the case of a nonlinear map, the rotation number is normally obtained numerically, by iterating the map for given initial conditions, or through a normal form analysis, a type of a perturbation theory for maps.

pmc-10743440.description: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and periodontitis are chronic inflammatory diseases that widely spread and share the same patterns of pro-inflammatory cytokines. pmc-11598951.title: Transcriptional Modulation of Plant Defense Genes by a Bipartite Begomovirus Promotes the Performance of Its Whitefly Vector
pmc-11598951.creator: Wen-Ze He, Shu-Sheng Liu, Li-Long Pan
pmc-11598951.description: The majority of plant viruses rely on insect vectors for inter-plant transmission. While many case studies on monopartite begomoviruses are available, bipartite begomoviruses are understudied. More importantly, detailed elucidation of the molecular mechanisms involved is limited.

pmc-12566944.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study explores the transcriptomic and physiological responses of two oat cultivars MN10253 (resistant) and Qingyin 1 (susceptible) to BYDV at 0, 2, 8, 24, and 48 h post-infection.

pmc-13358704.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Methyltransferase-like protein 3 (METTL3) is a promising therapeutic target for Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML).
